name: find_individuals
description: Find the live individuals of a kind (its specialisations included) whose fields meet every condition. Returns the search stated in English, how many individuals meet it, and the handles of the first ones, such as 'Cup#1'. Handles stay the same for the whole conversation; pass them to the other tools.

kind.description: A kind's identifier, or its plain name when no other kind shares it.

conditions.description: Conditions every individual found must meet.

path.description: Field names separated by dots, leading from the individual to the compared value, such as 'inertial.mass'.

comparison.description: How the value at the path is compared with the given value.

limit.description: How many of the individuals found to name.
